clips.title: Progress
paras: If you need another Twilight cultist's medallion of station, then I am happy to oblige. I will, however, need another brilliant shard and some abyssal crests...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here you are, friend. One more Twilight medallion of station. Use it well, and I wish you luck against the Abyssal Council!
